Class ThinkSeats

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.swing.ThinkSeats
final class ThinkSeats extends Object
The ThinkSeats class keeps one thinking pane per user and per scope. A scope with a group id is that user's merge group, and the group shares one pane. A scope with no group id is that one cell, and the cell does not share. The glass is still one strip. This seat decides which text that strip shows. Each user is one file under ~/.casserole/aetheris-thinking/. A clear of one user rewrites that file only. The legacy aetheris-thinking.txt file is not read and not written here.

  • Method Details

    • scope

      static String scope(String groupId, String cellId)
      The method returns the scope token for one cell. A non-empty group id returns g: plus that id. Any other cell returns c: plus the cell id.
      Parameters:
      groupId - the merge group, or empty when the cell stands alone
      cellId - the cell id
      Returns:
      the scope token

    • key

      static String key(String user, String groupId, String cellId)
      The method returns the map key for one user and one scope. The user and the scope are joined with SEP.
      Parameters:
      user - the sanitized user
      groupId - the merge group, or empty
      cellId - the cell id
      Returns:
      the key

    • word

      static String word(String model)
      The method turns a model id into the banner word. A null id is empty. A newline, a carriage return, and a box-drawing character are dropped. A blank result returns model. A word longer than 80 characters keeps the first 80.
      Parameters:
      model - the model id, or the short name
      Returns:
      the word painted between the box-drawing marks

    • beginText

      static String beginText(String text, String banner, String chunk)
      The method opens a block on stored text the same way the strip opens one. A pane that already has text gets a blank line first. The banner is two box-drawing characters, the word, and two more. The chunk follows the banner.
      Parameters:
      text - the pane text before this chunk
      banner - the banner word
      chunk - the first chunk of the block
      Returns:
      the pane text after the block opens

    • accept

      static void accept(ThinkSeats.ThinkPane pane, String cellId, String model, String chunk)
      The method applies one chunk to a stored pane. A different cell or a different banner word starts a header. The same cell and the same word append. A null pane, or an empty chunk, returns without a change.
      Parameters:
      pane - the stored pane
      cellId - the cell that produced the chunk
      model - the banner word
      chunk - the chunk

    • rememberFace

      void rememberFace(String user, String cellId, String groupId, String target)
      The method stores the group id and the execution target for a cell. A later chunk can seat that cell when its canvas is not on screen.
      Parameters:
      user - the sanitized user
      cellId - the cell id
      groupId - the merge group, or empty
      target - the execution target

    • finishCell

      void finishCell(String user, String cellId)
      The method closes the open block for the pane that last took this cell. A cell that was never seated is left alone.
      Parameters:
      user - the sanitized user
      cellId - the cell whose run paused

    • saveUser

      void saveUser(String user)
      The method writes one user's panes. A blocked file is left alone. An empty pane is omitted, so a clear drops that scope and leaves the others.
      Parameters:
      user - the sanitized user

    • load

      private void load(String user)
      The method loads one user's file the first time that user is touched. A missing file stays an empty seat. A version other than 1 blocks later writes and loads nothing. A loaded block is not live, so the next launch starts a header.
      Parameters:
      user - the sanitized user
